The other jellyfish are small and always stay blue, so there are (1 - 1/15)x = (14/15)x small jellyfish.
When a UV light turned on, 6 jellyfish changed color, so (14/15)x = 6.
To solve for x, multiply both sides of the equation by 15/14:
(14/15)x * (15/14) = 6 * (15/14)
x = 90/14
x = 6.428571428571429
Since the number of jellyfish must be a whole number, we round up to the nearest whole number:
x = 7
Therefore, there are 7 jellyfish in the tank.
